item.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Will play Monday night
item.description:
McMillan (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Monday's game against Tampa Bay, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

item.title: Tyler Higbee: Diagnosed with pulmonary contusion
item.description:
Higbee has been diagnosed with a pulmonary contusion that he sustained in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers in Week 12, and his status for Week 13 against the Chiefs on Thursday, Dec. 3 won't be known until Wednesday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Davante Adams: Won't return for Week 13
item.description:
The Rams are not expected to open the 21-day practice window for Adams (hamstring) ahead of the team's Week 13 game against the Chiefs, Nate Adkins of The Athletic reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Michael Pittman: Just one catch in return to lineup
item.description:
Pittman caught one of two targets for seven yards in Friday's 27-5 win over the Broncos.

item.title: DK Metcalf: Finds end zone against Broncos
item.description:
